observations: body L1: the example «الخمس عشرة درجة الاوّلة» runs over from the last line of p. 322 («الخمس») to the beginning of this line.
body L11: the line numbers are printed «15. 16, 17, 18», with a point after 15.
body L13, L14: in Woepcke's title «Fakhrì» and «Aboù» are printed with grave accents, «Alkarkhî» with a circumflex.
body L14, L27: a small mark before «Paris» (L14) and one over the e of «sphaerali» (L27) are not transcribed.
body L23: «ibn Aḥmad» is not letter-spaced, unlike «Muḥammad» and «ibn Ghāzī».

body L6, L25: the sign over the alif of «ألِفْ» and of «أدقّها» is the hamza alone (3.5 by 3.1 points, the shape of the hamza of «رأس» in L6), not a hamza with a damma; «رَدُّك» has no vowel on the k.
body L20, L28: «Caussin» is letter-spaced in L20, not in L28.
body L11, L21, L25: «البرهان» (L11), «ثالثة» (L21) and «وذلك» (L25) are printed with elongated joins (kashīda), not transcribed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
